districtFact: Hillsboro School District opens each reviewed school year in two grade groups, schedules a multi-day November sequence for grading, staff development, and Family Conference Connections, and publishes 173 student days. The last day for grades K-11 is an early-release day, followed by conditional June make-up dates that do not affect graduation dates.

about.title: About the Hillsboro School District Calendar
about.content: Hillsboro School District publishes a one-page district calendar with grade-specific openings, student no-school days, quarter and semester endings, Family Connections and Transitions, an early-release last day for grades K-11, and possible June make-up dates. This page reorganizes those items into a family-facing attendance calendar while preserving HSD's official labels.

about.title: HSD Uses Two First Days
about.content: Grades 1-6, 7, and 9 begin on the first printed student day. Kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10-12 begin the following day. Families should match the opening date to the student's grade instead of treating the first date as a districtwide start for every student.

about.title: November Combines Several No-School Reasons
about.content: HSD separates elementary workdays, secondary grade-preparation days, staff development, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and licensed non-contract days. These labels often create a longer November no-school window than a simple Thanksgiving-break summary would show.

about.title: June Make-Up Dates Are Conditional
about.content: The district schedules an early-release last day for grades K-11 and then identifies later June dates that may be added only after an inclement-weather closure. HSD states that graduation dates would not be affected by those make-up days.

planningTips.title: Hillsboro School District Calendar Notes
content: Match the first day to the student's grade; HSD uses a two-day opening sequence.
Read November as a sequence of workdays, conference connections, holidays, and non-contract days rather than one generic Thanksgiving break.
Treat quarter and semester endings as regular attendance days unless the calendar separately marks the following day as no school.
Use the scheduled K-11 last day for planning, but keep the listed June make-up dates flexible until HSD confirms whether they are needed.
Use the Spanish PDF for the same adopted district dates when a translated version is available.
Check HSD's calendar page after importing an ICS file because a one-time download does not update automatically.

districtFaqs.q: When does Hillsboro School District start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 start Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12 start Wednesday, September 2.

districtFaqs.q: How many student days are on the HSD 2026-27 calendar?
districtFaqs.a: HSD lists 173 student days: 88 in the first semester and 85 in the second semester.

districtFaqs.q: When is Hillsboro School District Winter Break in 2026-27?
districtFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21–31, 2026, with January 1 also marked as no school. Students return Monday, January 4, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: When is Hillsboro School District Spring Break in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

districtFaqs.q: When is the last day of Hillsboro School District in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for grades K–11 is Thursday, June 10, 2027, with early release. June 14–15 are possible make-up days and are used only if HSD needs to recover time after an inclement-weather closure.

districtFaqs.q: Does HSD publish a Spanish school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Hillsboro School District publishes Spanish editions of the 2026–27 and 2027–28 adopted district calendars.
